meta.note: Raw records are the source of truth. 'derivedStatus' and 'summary' are computed by the generator for verification; the UI should recompute them from the records. Payments are manually recorded amounts, not transfers.

statusMapping.applicationStatus: Uses frontend ApplicationStatus (pending/accepted/rejected/declined/withdrawn/completed) + `shortlisted` flag; hired = accepted/completed application with engagement CONFIRMED/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED.
statusMapping.jobStatus: `status` uses backend JobPostStatus (DRAFT/OPEN/CLOSED/COMPLETED); `derivedStatus` adds in_progress/filled from engagements.
statusMapping.category: `category` = existing app category (qualified/skill-based/beginner-friendly); `sector` = display grouping for the Job Categories chart (not in the current app).
